Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot recap + attachments (next steps)

Tom — great to speak this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Goal: 30-day pilot to validate latency and cost outcomes for summary+search flows.
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 250ms for the 512-token path and token cost target <$0.0015 per doc on average.
- Tech ask: SSO (SAML), audit logs for 90 days, and ability to export KV cache snapshots.
- Procurement: you mentioned legal would send redlines to our standard MSA.

Next steps I put on my side:
- Attach pilot-scope.pdf (scope + data flows) and mutual-action-plan.xlsx (timeline + owners)
- Monica will follow up on procurement/price bands for the trial
- We'll prepare SOC2 attestation and DPA for review

Availability: Monica or I can hop on a short call if legal has specific questions about data flows or retention during the pilot.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: pilot-scope.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Tom Harrington <tom.harrington@finserve.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@finserve.com>, FinServe Legal <legal@finserve.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot recap + attachments (next steps)

Thanks for the recap, Jasmine — appreciate the clear plan. Per our side we've routed to counsel and procurement. Legal attached redlines (see FinServe_Redlines.docx). High level of their asks:

- Logging/retention: ask to shorten Redwood's default logs retention to 30 days for pilot data.
- Data processing carveouts: stronger contractual restrictions around cache persistence and backup exports.
- SLA: a request for a 99.9% uptime commitment for the pilot (they want this in writing).

Can you confirm what items are negotiable for a time-limited pilot vs items that require platform changes? Procurement wants to understand effort/risk before they push the PO.

Tom Harrington
Head of Cloud Integrations, FinServe Technologies
Tom.Harrington@finserve.com | +1-617-555-0044

Attachments: FinServe_Redlines.docx (DOCX)

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Checking status on counsel redlines + proposed pilot concessions

Tom / Emily — looping Laura (counsel) and Monica (AM) to accelerate. Hope all is well. Following up on the redlines you shared on 6/12 — wanted to surface a practical path we typically use for pilots that keeps procurement comfortable while minimizing product work: 

1) Pilot-limited concessions we can accept quickly:
   - Logs retention: we can enforce a 30-day retention window scoped to pilot datasets via configuration and a written pilot addendum.
   - Cache persistence: confirm we will not enable KV snapshot exports for pilot customer data; snapshots are off by default for pilot tenancy.

2) Items needing legal review or platform work:
   - SLA language: our platform guarantees are backed by dedicated capacity options. For a short pilot we can offer a written operational commitment (target latency/backstop) and include an automatic fallback to hosted model variant if capacity is impacted, but a full 99.9% financial SLA requires a Dedicated contract and engineering change.

Laura — if helpful I attached FinServe_Redlines.docx and added inline notes in a redline-counter-summary.pdf to show quick counters and classification (pilot-acceptable / requires-dedicated).

Can you confirm expected procurement timing and whether a one-page quote for the pilot would help move this to PO? If timing is tight we can provide a 30-day invoice estimate today.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

1) Please share a one-page pilot quote (seat/usage bands and an estimated invoice for the 30-day pilot).
2) We need an explicit list of redlines you are willing to accept for pilot only (in writing) and a final counter for anything you cannot accept. Legal told me to expect counters by end of week so they can triage.

Quick summary:
- Accept for pilot: 30-day log retention (scoped), no KV snapshot exports for pilot tenancy, written pilot addendum limiting data usage and backup policies.
- Need Dedicated / further review: 99.9% financial SLA, permanent changes to data residency/backup architecture.

Pilot one-page quote (attached) - estimated invoice for 30 days: $18,500 (includes test data throughput and monitoring instrumentation).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF123456 (we will populate the pilot addendum + counters into the MSA addendum draft once you confirm acceptance)

Standing by to finalize; Laura is copied for any legal questions.
